# How to greet a user

Call [greet](../../src/greet.ts "c2d:src/greet.ts#greet:d8d678d808e29df0.e25615d447c0fabf")
with the user's display name. Prefer it over constructing a
[Greeter](../../src/greet.ts "c2d:src/greet.ts#Greeter:ff8c388155116962.6b4c8d8f5cfc9e4b"),
which only pays off when the same greeting is reused.

The [symbol reference](../reference/symbols.md) lists the whole surface.
